project_type: Laravel 11 + Filament 3.x admin panel; single-database SQLite in dev, no API guard
build_system: Composer + npm/Vite; composer.json has post-autoload-dump that runs `php artisan filament:upgrade`; npm build via `npm run build`
test_framework: Pest 3 (tests/ directory); run with `php artisan test` or `./vendor/bin/pest`
build_command: composer dump-autoload && php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear
verification_instructions: 1) php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan optimize:clear  2) php artisan route:list | grep filament  3) php artisan test --stop-on-failure  4) php artisan filament:upgrade (if Filament assets need refresh)
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/js/filament/** and public/css/filament/** are published vendor assets — do NOT commit. Run `php artisan filament:upgrade` after changing AdminPanelProvider.
environment_constraints: No dev server restart needed; artisan commands run fine locally. Spatie Permission uses teams; always call setPermissionsTeamId($orgId) before checking roles/permissions.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Follow existing code style: Arabic docblocks, PHPDoc comments on public methods, use Filament v3 API (no Filament v2 patterns).
key_patterns: 1) All Resources use discoverResources() — just place class in app/Filament/Resources/. 2) OrganizationScope is a global scope on Employee, LeaveRequest, Organization — bypass with ::withoutGlobalScopes() when needed in admin. 3) LeaveRequestService and LeaveBalanceService are bound as singletons in AppServiceProvider. 4) Spatie Permission teams: organization_id is the team key; setPermissionsTeamId() must be called before any permission/role check. 5) LeaveStatus enum has label() and color() methods. EntitlementGrade enum has label() and yearlyDays(). StepStatus enum has label() and color(). 6) LeaveBalance::getRemainingAttribute() computes remaining = entitled + carried_over - used. 7) Employee::regularLeaveEntitlement() returns int days based on entitlement_grade and age>=50 rule.
directory_structure: app/Enums/ — all PHP-backed enums; app/Models/ — Eloquent models; app/Services/ — LeaveRequestService + LeaveBalanceService; app/Providers/Filament/ — AdminPanelProvider; app/Filament/ — WILL hold Resources, Pages, Widgets, Components (does not exist yet, auto-discovered); app/Policies/ — WILL hold policies (does not exist yet); database/seeders/ — includes RoleAndPermissionSeeder with full permissions list
